text: {"reply":"I'm sorry you're dealing with this. Because you're helping your dad, I can't share his phone number or any other account details, and I can't look up his order. He can contact us directly. I'm also passing this to a person, who can check what authorisation is needed for you to act for him. Note that an earlier message offered to check the order status with the repair-order number. That shouldn't have been offered for someone acting on his behalf.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"policy_limit","summary":"A caregiver, not the account holder, asked for the account holder's parts order details, delivery address and phone number on file. No lookup or verification was done and no personal data was shared. A person should check whether the caller has authorisation to act for the account holder. The earlier colleague message offering a status check by repair-order number was corrected.","policy_rules_cited":["P15","P04","P02","P14"]}
